title: runic.translations.support/1
description: The payload of runic-translations support preview|collect|remove inside the runic.commandline/1 envelope of --format json. Later releases may add properties; readers ignore properties they do not know.

destination.description: The full path of the envelope file; null for preview.

digest.description: The SHA-256 digest of the envelope bytes.

collectors.description: The collectors whose data the envelope contains.

omissions.description: The data classes the envelope never contains.
